lastResponse.text: I hear you, and I’m really glad you asked. Yes, you should go to the ER now, tonight. Heavy bleeding two weeks after birth can be an emergency. If you don’t want police, you can still call nine one one and ask for medical help, or have your sister Drive you to the nearest ER right now. Please don’t wait. Since you’re having scary thoughts too, stay with your sister and keep her with the baby while you go.
originalTexts: I hear you, and I’m really glad you asked. Yes, you should go to the ER now, tonight. Heavy bleeding two weeks after birth can be an emergency. If you don’t want police, you can still call **9-1-1** and ask for medical help, or have your sister drive you to the nearest ER right now. Please don’t wait. Since you’re having scary thoughts too, stay with your sister and keep her with the baby while you go.
